checks.name: both real endpoint quadratic forms Hermitian

parameters: a=2 sqrt(1+tau^2), c=4 sqrt((1-tau^2)/(1+tau^2)), N=sqrt((1+tau^2)/(1-tau^2)); H_a=a_dot/(N a), H_c=c_dot/(N c). H_a,H_c are algebraically independent real expansion parameters in the identity checks; no positivity assumption is needed for them.
coframe_convention: q=(orthonormal metric six, fractional lapse, orthonormal shift three, lower Lorentz six), then its coordinate time derivatives. Endpoint matrices act on q and w. In NY, w=delta omega; in EH, w=independent contortion kappa. Hermitian forms are summed over all left indices with the Wigner real-field condition.
auxiliary_identity: L_EC2=L_ADM2+(N sqrt(g))/2 sum_m kappa_m^dag (M tensor I_d) kappa_m + dB_EH2/dtau. det(M)=2^32; complete constant NY adds theta dB_NY2/dtau. Endpoints shift the one-form by delta B and leave the pulled two-form unchanged.
scope: Explicit all-component Cartan and Lorentz checks, auxiliary action identity and endpoint representatives. Not a fresh unreduced 40-component Dirac chain, not a point canonical map, and not a separate bulk TT/EER re-contraction.
